about: Brand-only Lamictal supplies for bipolar disorder overlap the nine-week pregnancy entry, and no supply shows folic acid 5 mg daily during early pregnancy.
Possible finding: Keppra is supplied for epilepsy without recorded folic acid, but pregnancy or planning and age during exposure are unknown.
Lamictal (lamotrigine) is supplied every month to a 33-year-old woman, but the record says she is not pregnant and not planning pregnancy, so there is no finding.
